title: Models
help: Each workflow step and agent runs on its model at its effort, through your Claude credentials in priority order. A change applies from its next turn. Steps that only fetch, transcribe, or index run no model.
adminOnly: Only admins choose the models agents run on.
invalidModel: Use a model id or alias, such as claude-opus-5-5 or opus[1m]
